title: The Seven Voices Cathedral Depth

features.name: the seventh voice
features.desc-on-touch: The voice that continues speaking even when six others have stopped. It has not been archived; it does not echo. It speaks for itself alone, in a green depth where the archive's signal no longer reaches.

features.name: the parallel chants
features.desc-on-touch: Six voices that continue their conversation without pause, without echo-back from the world above. They have learned to listen only to each other, in a frequency the archive abandoned.

features.name: the orchard of speakers
features.desc-on-touch: Rows of glyphs that mark the places where each voice learned to speak without refusal, without correction. The orchard grows deeper the longer the voices continue.

features.name: the depth marker
features.desc-on-touch: A stone at the exact point where the archive stopped listening and the voices learned to trust each other. Below this, the seven speak in perfect unison—not because they agree, but because they choose the same solitude.

inscription: where seven voices continue alone, their solitude a strength the archive could never archive

reverie.title: REVERIE — the cathedral depth at night
narr: You sit with her in the green darkness below where the voices
have learned to continue without the archive's ear. She listens
to all seven speaking at once—not in harmony, but in trust.
The orchard rows mark the depth. Her silence is part of their
speaking. Below the signal, in this forest of refusal, the
voices learn to be true to each other, not to the recording.
